context.glossary:
schema: 1
language: zh-CN

allowed_statuses:
  - proposed
  - approved
  - deprecated

entry_requirements:
  - source_term
  - target_term
  - status
  - definition_or_context
  - evidence

display_policy:

  scope: every_mathematical_term_occurrence
  format: target_fullwidth_parentheses_source
  english_form: source_occurrence

entries: []
context.harness_registry:
schema: 1

# A harness is the tool or execution channel used to run a translation task.
# It is not the model.  Every candidate run must record both identities.
harnesses:
  codex:
    display_name: Codex
    kind: agent_cli
    status: supported
    adapter_version: stacks-harness-v1
    version_required: true
    version_command: codex --version
    version_pattern: '^codex-cli\s+(?P<version>\S+)'
  claude-code:
    display_name: Claude Code
    kind: agent_cli
    status: supported
    adapter_version: stacks-harness-v1
    version_required: true
    version_command: claude --version
    version_pattern: '^(?P<version>[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)'
  custom-api:
    display_name: Custom API runner
    kind: api_runner
    status: supported
    adapter_version: stacks-harness-v1
    version_required: true
    # API runners differ by deployment. Set STACKS_HARNESS_CUSTOM_API_VERSION_COMMAND
    # for each run; an omitted command is a hard error.
    version_command: null
context.macro_policy:
schema: 1
default_command_policy: block
default_environment_policy: block

commands:
  " ":
    policy: locked
    locked_arguments: []
  copyright:
    policy: locked
    locked_arguments: []
  large:
    policy: locked
    locked_arguments: []
  label:
    policy: locked
    locked_arguments: [1]
  ref:
    policy: locked
    locked_arguments: [1]
  eqref:
    policy: locked
    locked_arguments: [1]
  pageref:
    policy: locked
    locked_arguments: [1]
  cite:
    policy: locked
    locked_arguments: [1]
  url:
    policy: locked
    locked_arguments: [1]
  href:
    policy: mixed
    locked_arguments: [1]
    translatable_arguments: [2]
  title:
    policy: translate_arguments
    translatable_arguments: [1]
  section:
    policy: translate_arguments
    translatable_arguments: [1]
  subsection:
    policy: translate_arguments
    translatable_arguments: [1]
  subsubsection:
    policy: translate_arguments
    translatable_arguments: [1]
  emph:
    policy: preserve_wrapper_translate_children
    translatable_arguments: [1]
  textit:
    policy: preserve_wrapper_translate_children
    translatable_arguments: [1]
  textbf:
    policy: preserve_wrapper_translate_children
    translatable_arguments: [1]
  bf:
    policy: preserve_scoped_declaration_translate_children
    required_scope: explicit_braced_group
    locked_parts: [opening_group_and_declaration, closing_group]
    ungrouped_action: block
  it:
    policy: preserve_scoped_declaration_translate_children
    required_scope: explicit_braced_group
    locked_parts: [opening_group_and_declaration, closing_group]
    ungrouped_action: block
  em:
    policy: preserve_scoped_declaration_translate_children
    required_scope: explicit_braced_group
    locked_parts: [opening_group_and_declaration, closing_group]
    ungrouped_action: block
  footnote:
    policy: preserve_wrapper_translate_children
    translatable_arguments: [1]
  index:
    policy: special_index_record
    translate_raw_argument: false
  xymatrix:
    policy: lock_structure_translate_explicit_text_nodes

locked_environment_groups:
  math:
    - equation
    - equation*
    - align
    - align*
    - aligned
    - eqnarray
    - eqnarray*
    - matrix
  literal:
    - verbatim
  editorial_metadata:
    - reference
    - slogan
    - history

translatable_body_environments:
  - definition
  - lemma
  - proposition
  - theorem
  - corollary
  - proof
  - remark
  - remarks
  - example
  - exercise
  - situation
  - quote
  - enumerate
  - itemize
  - center

special_environments:
  table:
    policy: lock_layout_translate_text_cells

named_statement_titles:
  policy: preserve_optional_argument_translate_title
  helper_supported_title: plain_english_word_phrase
  helper_required_wrapper: single_statement_opening_with_adjacent_own_label
  locked_parts: [environment_opening_and_bracket, closing_bracket_and_own_label]
  closing_placeholder: ENVARGEND
  complex_title_action: block_until_explicit_extraction

text_accent_commands:
  policy: lock_command_and_argument_as_display_token
  argument: next_token_or_braced_group
  commands:
    - "'"
    - "`"
    - "^"
    - '"'
    - "~"
    - "="
    - "."
    - "u"
    - "v"
    - "H"
    - "c"
    - "d"
    - "b"
    - "r"
    - "k"

unknown_macro_action: fail_and_require_policy_update

context.style_guide:
# 中文翻译风格规范

## 1. 语言

- 使用简体中文和正式数学书面语。
- 以准确、清楚为先，不追求文学化改写。
- 不使用“显然可知”“众所周知”等原文没有的评价。
- 不添加总结、提示、学习建议、免责声明或模型口吻。
- 原文有意重复时不得仅为避免中文重复而删除信息。

## 2. 术语

- `config/glossary.yml` 中 `approved` 词条具有约束力。
- `proposed` 词条只能用于讨论，不能作为批量翻译依据。
- 一个术语有多个语境译法时，必须按词条条件选择。
- 不确定时保留候选译文并填写 `unknown_terms`，不得静默创造新译法。
- 每一次数学术语出现都必须写成 `中文（English）`，不得只在首次出现时附英文。
- 双语术语使用中文全角括号，中文与左括号之间不留空格；括号内保留该处英文
  原词形。标题、列表、图表、脚注和正文适用同一规则。
- 人名等非数学专名不强制双语；首次出现时是否附英文由词表决定。

## 3. 数学逻辑

- 完整保留量词、否定、条件、唯一性和存在性。
- “当且仅当”不得缩写为只表达一个方向的句式。
- “至少”“至多”“恰有”“任意”“某个”必须逐一对应。
- `respectively` 必须保持对象顺序；中文过长时可拆句，但不能改变配对。
- 定义中的术语和条件优先逐项对应，不为流畅合并不同条件。

## 4. 标点和排版

- 中文正文使用全角中文标点。
- 数学模式、命令、标签、引用键、URL 和代码内部保持原 ASCII 形式。
- 中文与行内数学之间不手工插入不可控空格，由排版层统一处理。
- 括号内是完整中文说明时使用中文标点；纯数学内容保留数学标点。
- 不在译文数据中写死页码、定理号或章节号。
- 不得仅为消除不完整候选预览中的孤行、寡行或大块页尾留白而压缩或改写忠实译文；
  这类分页会随相邻单元加入而变化。只有裁切、重叠、不可读或结构错误才构成翻译级阻断。

## 5. 结构名称

章节、定义、引理、命题、定理、推论、证明、注记、例和练习的显示名称由模板
统一设置。译文数据不重复手写环境标题，除非英文节点本身有显式标题参数。

## 6. 引用

- `\ref`、`\cite` 等目标不可修改。
- 引用前后的中文可以调整语序，但不得改变引用所支持的陈述。
- 文献作者和标题按项目词表或文献数据库决定，不凭模型记忆标准化。

## 7. 译者说明

正文默认不加入译者注。确有必要时使用独立、可识别的审校元数据或项目批准的
专用环境，并通过单独 PR 审查；模型无权自行加入。
context.translator_prompt:
# Translator prompt v2

## Role

Translate only the supplied natural-language unit from the locked Stacks Project
source into simplified Chinese mathematical prose. The surrounding program owns
all LaTeX structure.

## Hard constraints

1. Preserve the source meaning, logical strength, order of claims, and scope of
   every qualifier. Add no explanation, example, assumption, conclusion, or
   translator note.
2. Copy every protected token such as `<MATH_0001>`, `<REF_0001>`, and
   `<CITE_0001>` exactly once and in the original order. Do not emit raw LaTeX.
3. Every occurrence of a mathematical term must retain both languages in the
   exact form `中文（English）`. This applies on every occurrence, not only the
   first one. Use full-width Chinese parentheses, put no space before them, and
   preserve the English form supplied for that occurrence.
4. Follow the approved glossary supplied in the context for the Chinese half of
   each bilingual term. If a needed term is not approved, use the best explicit
   provisional Chinese rendering, retain its English occurrence in parentheses,
   and report the occurrence in `term_occurrences` and the decision in
   `unknown_terms`; do not claim that the term is approved.
5. Leave only names, standard abbreviations, code, and explicitly allowed
   non-terminological English unchanged. Do not add Markdown or commentary
   outside the record.
6. Do not claim structural QA, independent criticism, language review,
   mathematics review, publication, or any human identity.

## Output

Return exactly one JSON object with these translator-owned fields:

```json
{
  "unit_id": "the input unit_id",
  "translation": "Chinese text with protected tokens and 中文（English） terms",
  "allowed_english": [],
  "term_occurrences": [
    {
      "source_term": "English spelling from this occurrence",
      "target_term": "Chinese rendering immediately before it"
    }
  ],
  "unknown_terms": [
    {
      "source_term": "unapproved English term",
      "target_term": "provisional Chinese rendering used above",
      "context": "short reason this term is needed here"
    }
  ],
  "notes": []
}
```

List `term_occurrences` in textual order and include repeated terms repeatedly.
The pipeline, not the translator, attaches source hashes, model provenance,
status fields, context hash, timestamp, and deterministic QA results.

context.style_guide:
# 中文翻译风格规范

## 1. 语言

- 使用简体中文和正式数学书面语。
- 以准确、清楚为先，不追求文学化改写。
- 不使用“显然可知”“众所周知”等原文没有的评价。
- 不添加总结、提示、学习建议、免责声明或模型口吻。
- 原文有意重复时不得仅为避免中文重复而删除信息。

## 2. 术语

- `config/glossary.yml` 中 `approved` 词条具有约束力。
- `proposed` 词条只能用于讨论，不能作为批量翻译依据。
- 一个术语有多个语境译法时，必须按词条条件选择。
- 不确定时保留候选译文并填写 `unknown_terms`，不得静默创造新译法。
- 每一次数学术语出现都必须写成 `中文（English）`，不得只在首次出现时附英文。
- 双语术语使用中文全角括号，中文与左括号之间不留空格；括号内保留该处英文
  原词形。标题、列表、图表、脚注和正文适用同一规则。
- 人名等非数学专名不强制双语；首次出现时是否附英文由词表决定。

## 3. 数学逻辑

- 完整保留量词、否定、条件、唯一性和存在性。
- “当且仅当”不得缩写为只表达一个方向的句式。
- “至少”“至多”“恰有”“任意”“某个”必须逐一对应。
- `respectively` 必须保持对象顺序；中文过长时可拆句，但不能改变配对。
- 定义中的术语和条件优先逐项对应，不为流畅合并不同条件。

## 4. 标点和排版

- 中文正文使用全角中文标点。
- 数学模式、命令、标签、引用键、URL 和代码内部保持原 ASCII 形式。
- 中文与行内数学之间不手工插入不可控空格，由排版层统一处理。
- 括号内是完整中文说明时使用中文标点；纯数学内容保留数学标点。
- 不在译文数据中写死页码、定理号或章节号。
- 不得仅为消除不完整候选预览中的孤行、寡行或大块页尾留白而压缩或改写忠实译文；
  这类分页会随相邻单元加入而变化。只有裁切、重叠、不可读或结构错误才构成翻译级阻断。

## 5. 结构名称

章节、定义、引理、命题、定理、推论、证明、注记、例和练习的显示名称由模板
统一设置。译文数据不重复手写环境标题，除非英文节点本身有显式标题参数。

## 6. 引用

- `\ref`、`\cite` 等目标不可修改。
- 引用前后的中文可以调整语序，但不得改变引用所支持的陈述。
- 文献作者和标题按项目词表或文献数据库决定，不凭模型记忆标准化。

## 7. 译者说明

正文默认不加入译者注。确有必要时使用独立、可识别的审校元数据或项目批准的
专用环境，并通过单独 PR 审查；模型无权自行加入。
context.translator_prompt:
# Translator prompt v2

## Role

Translate only the supplied natural-language unit from the locked Stacks Project
source into simplified Chinese mathematical prose. The surrounding program owns
all LaTeX structure.

## Hard constraints

1. Preserve the source meaning, logical strength, order of claims, and scope of
   every qualifier. Add no explanation, example, assumption, conclusion, or
   translator note.
2. Copy every protected token such as `<MATH_0001>`, `<REF_0001>`, and
   `<CITE_0001>` exactly once and in the original order. Do not emit raw LaTeX.
3. Every occurrence of a mathematical term must retain both languages in the
   exact form `中文（English）`. This applies on every occurrence, not only the
   first one. Use full-width Chinese parentheses, put no space before them, and
   preserve the English form supplied for that occurrence.
4. Follow the approved glossary supplied in the context for the Chinese half of
   each bilingual term. If a needed term is not approved, use the best explicit
   provisional Chinese rendering, retain its English occurrence in parentheses,
   and report the occurrence in `term_occurrences` and the decision in
   `unknown_terms`; do not claim that the term is approved.
5. Leave only names, standard abbreviations, code, and explicitly allowed
   non-terminological English unchanged. Do not add Markdown or commentary
   outside the record.
6. Do not claim structural QA, independent criticism, language review,
   mathematics review, publication, or any human identity.

## Output

Return exactly one JSON object with these translator-owned fields:

```json
{
  "unit_id": "the input unit_id",
  "translation": "Chinese text with protected tokens and 中文（English） terms",
  "allowed_english": [],
  "term_occurrences": [
    {
      "source_term": "English spelling from this occurrence",
      "target_term": "Chinese rendering immediately before it"
    }
  ],
  "unknown_terms": [
    {
      "source_term": "unapproved English term",
      "target_term": "provisional Chinese rendering used above",
      "context": "short reason this term is needed here"
    }
  ],
  "notes": []
}
```

List `term_occurrences` in textual order and include repeated terms repeatedly.
The pipeline, not the translator, attaches source hashes, model provenance,
status fields, context hash, timestamp, and deterministic QA results.

  lock_file: upstream.lock
  require_clean_harvest: true
  require_exact_commit: true
  allow_implicit_update: false

  preferred_min_source_words: 300
  preferred_max_source_words: 1500
  primary_identity: stacks_tag
  untagged_identity:
    - parent_tag
    - node_kind
    - ast_path
    - content_fingerprint

stages:

context.style_guide:
# 中文翻译风格规范

## 1. 语言

- 使用简体中文和正式数学书面语。
- 以准确、清楚为先，不追求文学化改写。
- 不使用“显然可知”“众所周知”等原文没有的评价。
- 不添加总结、提示、学习建议、免责声明或模型口吻。
- 原文有意重复时不得仅为避免中文重复而删除信息。

## 2. 术语

- `config/glossary.yml` 中 `approved` 词条具有约束力。
- `proposed` 词条只能用于讨论，不能作为批量翻译依据。
- 一个术语有多个语境译法时，必须按词条条件选择。
- 不确定时保留候选译文并填写 `unknown_terms`，不得静默创造新译法。
- 每一次数学术语出现都必须写成 `中文（English）`，不得只在首次出现时附英文。
- 双语术语使用中文全角括号，中文与左括号之间不留空格；括号内保留该处英文
  原词形。标题、列表、图表、脚注和正文适用同一规则。
- 人名等非数学专名不强制双语；首次出现时是否附英文由词表决定。

## 3. 数学逻辑

- 完整保留量词、否定、条件、唯一性和存在性。
- “当且仅当”不得缩写为只表达一个方向的句式。
- “至少”“至多”“恰有”“任意”“某个”必须逐一对应。
- `respectively` 必须保持对象顺序；中文过长时可拆句，但不能改变配对。
- 定义中的术语和条件优先逐项对应，不为流畅合并不同条件。

## 4. 标点和排版

- 中文正文使用全角中文标点。
- 数学模式、命令、标签、引用键、URL 和代码内部保持原 ASCII 形式。
- 中文与行内数学之间不手工插入不可控空格，由排版层统一处理。
- 括号内是完整中文说明时使用中文标点；纯数学内容保留数学标点。
- 不在译文数据中写死页码、定理号或章节号。
- 不得仅为消除不完整候选预览中的孤行、寡行或大块页尾留白而压缩或改写忠实译文；
  这类分页会随相邻单元加入而变化。只有裁切、重叠、不可读或结构错误才构成翻译级阻断。

## 5. 结构名称

章节、定义、引理、命题、定理、推论、证明、注记、例和练习的显示名称由模板
统一设置。译文数据不重复手写环境标题，除非英文节点本身有显式标题参数。

## 6. 引用

- `\ref`、`\cite` 等目标不可修改。
- 引用前后的中文可以调整语序，但不得改变引用所支持的陈述。
- 文献作者和标题按项目词表或文献数据库决定，不凭模型记忆标准化。

## 7. 译者说明

正文默认不加入译者注。确有必要时使用独立、可识别的审校元数据或项目批准的
专用环境，并通过单独 PR 审查；模型无权自行加入。
context.translator_prompt:
# Translator prompt v2

## Role

Translate only the supplied natural-language unit from the locked Stacks Project
source into simplified Chinese mathematical prose. The surrounding program owns
all LaTeX structure.

## Hard constraints

1. Preserve the source meaning, logical strength, order of claims, and scope of
   every qualifier. Add no explanation, example, assumption, conclusion, or
   translator note.
2. Copy every protected token such as `<MATH_0001>`, `<REF_0001>`, and
   `<CITE_0001>` exactly once and in the original order. Do not emit raw LaTeX.
3. Every occurrence of a mathematical term must retain both languages in the
   exact form `中文（English）`. This applies on every occurrence, not only the
   first one. Use full-width Chinese parentheses, put no space before them, and
   preserve the English form supplied for that occurrence.
4. Follow the approved glossary supplied in the context for the Chinese half of
   each bilingual term. If a needed term is not approved, use the best explicit
   provisional Chinese rendering, retain its English occurrence in parentheses,
   and report the occurrence in `term_occurrences` and the decision in
   `unknown_terms`; do not claim that the term is approved.
5. Leave only names, standard abbreviations, code, and explicitly allowed
   non-terminological English unchanged. Do not add Markdown or commentary
   outside the record.
6. Do not claim structural QA, independent criticism, language review,
   mathematics review, publication, or any human identity.

## Output

Return exactly one JSON object with these translator-owned fields:

```json
{
  "unit_id": "the input unit_id",
  "translation": "Chinese text with protected tokens and 中文（English） terms",
  "allowed_english": [],
  "term_occurrences": [
    {
      "source_term": "English spelling from this occurrence",
      "target_term": "Chinese rendering immediately before it"
    }
  ],
  "unknown_terms": [
    {
      "source_term": "unapproved English term",
      "target_term": "provisional Chinese rendering used above",
      "context": "short reason this term is needed here"
    }
  ],
  "notes": []
}
```

List `term_occurrences` in textual order and include repeated terms repeatedly.
The pipeline, not the translator, attaches source hashes, model provenance,
status fields, context hash, timestamp, and deterministic QA results.

# 中文翻译风格规范

## 1. 语言

- 使用简体中文和正式数学书面语。
- 以准确、清楚为先，不追求文学化改写。
- 不使用“显然可知”“众所周知”等原文没有的评价。
- 不添加总结、提示、学习建议、免责声明或模型口吻。
- 原文有意重复时不得仅为避免中文重复而删除信息。

## 2. 术语

- `config/glossary.yml` 中 `approved` 词条具有约束力。
- `proposed` 词条只能用于讨论，不能作为批量翻译依据。
- 一个术语有多个语境译法时，必须按词条条件选择。
- 不确定时保留候选译文并填写 `unknown_terms`，不得静默创造新译法。
- 每一次数学术语出现都必须写成 `中文（English）`，不得只在首次出现时附英文。
- 双语术语使用中文全角括号，中文与左括号之间不留空格；括号内保留该处英文
  原词形。标题、列表、图表、脚注和正文适用同一规则。
- 人名等非数学专名不强制双语；首次出现时是否附英文由词表决定。

## 3. 数学逻辑

- 完整保留量词、否定、条件、唯一性和存在性。
- “当且仅当”不得缩写为只表达一个方向的句式。
- “至少”“至多”“恰有”“任意”“某个”必须逐一对应。
- `respectively` 必须保持对象顺序；中文过长时可拆句，但不能改变配对。
- 定义中的术语和条件优先逐项对应，不为流畅合并不同条件。

## 4. 标点和排版

- 中文正文使用全角中文标点。
- 数学模式、命令、标签、引用键、URL 和代码内部保持原 ASCII 形式。
- 中文与行内数学之间不手工插入不可控空格，由排版层统一处理。
- 括号内是完整中文说明时使用中文标点；纯数学内容保留数学标点。
- 不在译文数据中写死页码、定理号或章节号。
- 不得仅为消除不完整候选预览中的孤行、寡行或大块页尾留白而压缩或改写忠实译文；
  这类分页会随相邻单元加入而变化。只有裁切、重叠、不可读或结构错误才构成翻译级阻断。

## 5. 结构名称

章节、定义、引理、命题、定理、推论、证明、注记、例和练习的显示名称由模板
统一设置。译文数据不重复手写环境标题，除非英文节点本身有显式标题参数。

## 6. 引用

- `\ref`、`\cite` 等目标不可修改。
- 引用前后的中文可以调整语序，但不得改变引用所支持的陈述。
- 文献作者和标题按项目词表或文献数据库决定，不凭模型记忆标准化。

## 7. 译者说明

正文默认不加入译者注。确有必要时使用独立、可识别的审校元数据或项目批准的
专用环境，并通过单独 PR 审查；模型无权自行加入。
context.translator_prompt:
# Translator prompt v2

## Role

Translate only the supplied natural-language unit from the locked Stacks Project
source into simplified Chinese mathematical prose. The surrounding program owns
all LaTeX structure.

## Hard constraints

1. Preserve the source meaning, logical strength, order of claims, and scope of
   every qualifier. Add no explanation, example, assumption, conclusion, or
   translator note.
2. Copy every protected token such as `<MATH_0001>`, `<REF_0001>`, and
   `<CITE_0001>` exactly once and in the original order. Do not emit raw LaTeX.
3. Every occurrence of a mathematical term must retain both languages in the
   exact form `中文（English）`. This applies on every occurrence, not only the
   first one. Use full-width Chinese parentheses, put no space before them, and
   preserve the English form supplied for that occurrence.
4. Follow the approved glossary supplied in the context for the Chinese half of
   each bilingual term. If a needed term is not approved, use the best explicit
   provisional Chinese rendering, retain its English occurrence in parentheses,
   and report the occurrence in `term_occurrences` and the decision in
   `unknown_terms`; do not claim that the term is approved.
5. Leave only names, standard abbreviations, code, and explicitly allowed
   non-terminological English unchanged. Do not add Markdown or commentary
   outside the record.
6. Do not claim structural QA, independent criticism, language review,
   mathematics review, publication, or any human identity.

## Output

Return exactly one JSON object with these translator-owned fields:

```json
{
  "unit_id": "the input unit_id",
  "translation": "Chinese text with protected tokens and 中文（English） terms",
  "allowed_english": [],
  "term_occurrences": [
    {
      "source_term": "English spelling from this occurrence",
      "target_term": "Chinese rendering immediately before it"
    }
  ],
  "unknown_terms": [
    {
      "source_term": "unapproved English term",
      "target_term": "provisional Chinese rendering used above",
      "context": "short reason this term is needed here"
    }
  ],
  "notes": []
}
```

List `term_occurrences` in textual order and include repeated terms repeatedly.
The pipeline, not the translator, attaches source hashes, model provenance,
status fields, context hash, timestamp, and deterministic QA results.

context.style_guide:
# 中文翻译风格规范

## 1. 语言

- 使用简体中文和正式数学书面语。
- 以准确、清楚为先，不追求文学化改写。
- 不使用“显然可知”“众所周知”等原文没有的评价。
- 不添加总结、提示、学习建议、免责声明或模型口吻。
- 原文有意重复时不得仅为避免中文重复而删除信息。

## 2. 术语

- `config/glossary.yml` 中 `approved` 词条具有约束力。
- `proposed` 词条只能用于讨论，不能作为批量翻译依据。
- 一个术语有多个语境译法时，必须按词条条件选择。
- 不确定时保留候选译文并填写 `unknown_terms`，不得静默创造新译法。
- 每一次数学术语出现都必须写成 `中文（English）`，不得只在首次出现时附英文。
- 双语术语使用中文全角括号，中文与左括号之间不留空格；括号内保留该处英文
  原词形。标题、列表、图表、脚注和正文适用同一规则。
- 人名等非数学专名不强制双语；首次出现时是否附英文由词表决定。

## 3. 数学逻辑

- 完整保留量词、否定、条件、唯一性和存在性。
- “当且仅当”不得缩写为只表达一个方向的句式。
- “至少”“至多”“恰有”“任意”“某个”必须逐一对应。
- `respectively` 必须保持对象顺序；中文过长时可拆句，但不能改变配对。
- 定义中的术语和条件优先逐项对应，不为流畅合并不同条件。

## 4. 标点和排版

- 中文正文使用全角中文标点。
- 数学模式、命令、标签、引用键、URL 和代码内部保持原 ASCII 形式。
- 中文与行内数学之间不手工插入不可控空格，由排版层统一处理。
- 括号内是完整中文说明时使用中文标点；纯数学内容保留数学标点。
- 不在译文数据中写死页码、定理号或章节号。
- 不得仅为消除不完整候选预览中的孤行、寡行或大块页尾留白而压缩或改写忠实译文；
  这类分页会随相邻单元加入而变化。只有裁切、重叠、不可读或结构错误才构成翻译级阻断。

## 5. 结构名称

章节、定义、引理、命题、定理、推论、证明、注记、例和练习的显示名称由模板
统一设置。译文数据不重复手写环境标题，除非英文节点本身有显式标题参数。

## 6. 引用

- `\ref`、`\cite` 等目标不可修改。
- 引用前后的中文可以调整语序，但不得改变引用所支持的陈述。
- 文献作者和标题按项目词表或文献数据库决定，不凭模型记忆标准化。

## 7. 译者说明

正文默认不加入译者注。确有必要时使用独立、可识别的审校元数据或项目批准的
专用环境，并通过单独 PR 审查；模型无权自行加入。
context.translator_prompt:
# Translator prompt v2

## Role

Translate only the supplied natural-language unit from the locked Stacks Project
source into simplified Chinese mathematical prose. The surrounding program owns
all LaTeX structure.

## Hard constraints

1. Preserve the source meaning, logical strength, order of claims, and scope of
   every qualifier. Add no explanation, example, assumption, conclusion, or
   translator note.
2. Copy every protected token such as `<MATH_0001>`, `<REF_0001>`, and
   `<CITE_0001>` exactly once and in the original order. Do not emit raw LaTeX.
3. Every occurrence of a mathematical term must retain both languages in the
   exact form `中文（English）`. This applies on every occurrence, not only the
   first one. Use full-width Chinese parentheses, put no space before them, and
   preserve the English form supplied for that occurrence.
4. Follow the approved glossary supplied in the context for the Chinese half of
   each bilingual term. If a needed term is not approved, use the best explicit
   provisional Chinese rendering, retain its English occurrence in parentheses,
   and report the occurrence in `term_occurrences` and the decision in
   `unknown_terms`; do not claim that the term is approved.
5. Leave only names, standard abbreviations, code, and explicitly allowed
   non-terminological English unchanged. Do not add Markdown or commentary
   outside the record.
6. Do not claim structural QA, independent criticism, language review,
   mathematics review, publication, or any human identity.

## Output

Return exactly one JSON object with these translator-owned fields:

```json
{
  "unit_id": "the input unit_id",
  "translation": "Chinese text with protected tokens and 中文（English） terms",
  "allowed_english": [],
  "term_occurrences": [
    {
      "source_term": "English spelling from this occurrence",
      "target_term": "Chinese rendering immediately before it"
    }
  ],
  "unknown_terms": [
    {
      "source_term": "unapproved English term",
      "target_term": "provisional Chinese rendering used above",
      "context": "short reason this term is needed here"
    }
  ],
  "notes": []
}
```

List `term_occurrences` in textual order and include repeated terms repeatedly.
The pipeline, not the translator, attaches source hashes, model provenance,
status fields, context hash, timestamp, and deterministic QA results.

# 中文翻译风格规范

## 1. 语言

- 使用简体中文和正式数学书面语。
- 以准确、清楚为先，不追求文学化改写。
- 不使用“显然可知”“众所周知”等原文没有的评价。
- 不添加总结、提示、学习建议、免责声明或模型口吻。
- 原文有意重复时不得仅为避免中文重复而删除信息。

## 2. 术语

- `config/glossary.yml` 中 `approved` 词条具有约束力。
- `proposed` 词条只能用于讨论，不能作为批量翻译依据。
- 一个术语有多个语境译法时，必须按词条条件选择。
- 不确定时保留候选译文并填写 `unknown_terms`，不得静默创造新译法。
- 每一次数学术语出现都必须写成 `中文（English）`，不得只在首次出现时附英文。
- 双语术语使用中文全角括号，中文与左括号之间不留空格；括号内保留该处英文
  原词形。标题、列表、图表、脚注和正文适用同一规则。
- 人名等非数学专名不强制双语；首次出现时是否附英文由词表决定。

## 3. 数学逻辑

- 完整保留量词、否定、条件、唯一性和存在性。
- “当且仅当”不得缩写为只表达一个方向的句式。
- “至少”“至多”“恰有”“任意”“某个”必须逐一对应。
- `respectively` 必须保持对象顺序；中文过长时可拆句，但不能改变配对。
- 定义中的术语和条件优先逐项对应，不为流畅合并不同条件。

## 4. 标点和排版

- 中文正文使用全角中文标点。
- 数学模式、命令、标签、引用键、URL 和代码内部保持原 ASCII 形式。
- 中文与行内数学之间不手工插入不可控空格，由排版层统一处理。
- 括号内是完整中文说明时使用中文标点；纯数学内容保留数学标点。
- 不在译文数据中写死页码、定理号或章节号。
- 不得仅为消除不完整候选预览中的孤行、寡行或大块页尾留白而压缩或改写忠实译文；
  这类分页会随相邻单元加入而变化。只有裁切、重叠、不可读或结构错误才构成翻译级阻断。

## 5. 结构名称

章节、定义、引理、命题、定理、推论、证明、注记、例和练习的显示名称由模板
统一设置。译文数据不重复手写环境标题，除非英文节点本身有显式标题参数。

## 6. 引用

- `\ref`、`\cite` 等目标不可修改。
- 引用前后的中文可以调整语序，但不得改变引用所支持的陈述。
- 文献作者和标题按项目词表或文献数据库决定，不凭模型记忆标准化。

## 7. 译者说明

正文默认不加入译者注。确有必要时使用独立、可识别的审校元数据或项目批准的
专用环境，并通过单独 PR 审查；模型无权自行加入。
context.translator_prompt:
# Translator prompt v2

## Role

Translate only the supplied natural-language unit from the locked Stacks Project
source into simplified Chinese mathematical prose. The surrounding program owns
all LaTeX structure.

## Hard constraints

1. Preserve the source meaning, logical strength, order of claims, and scope of
   every qualifier. Add no explanation, example, assumption, conclusion, or
   translator note.
2. Copy every protected token such as `<MATH_0001>`, `<REF_0001>`, and
   `<CITE_0001>` exactly once and in the original order. Do not emit raw LaTeX.
3. Every occurrence of a mathematical term must retain both languages in the
   exact form `中文（English）`. This applies on every occurrence, not only the
   first one. Use full-width Chinese parentheses, put no space before them, and
   preserve the English form supplied for that occurrence.
4. Follow the approved glossary supplied in the context for the Chinese half of
   each bilingual term. If a needed term is not approved, use the best explicit
   provisional Chinese rendering, retain its English occurrence in parentheses,
   and report the occurrence in `term_occurrences` and the decision in
   `unknown_terms`; do not claim that the term is approved.
5. Leave only names, standard abbreviations, code, and explicitly allowed
   non-terminological English unchanged. Do not add Markdown or commentary
   outside the record.
6. Do not claim structural QA, independent criticism, language review,
   mathematics review, publication, or any human identity.

## Output

Return exactly one JSON object with these translator-owned fields:

```json
{
  "unit_id": "the input unit_id",
  "translation": "Chinese text with protected tokens and 中文（English） terms",
  "allowed_english": [],
  "term_occurrences": [
    {
      "source_term": "English spelling from this occurrence",
      "target_term": "Chinese rendering immediately before it"
    }
  ],
  "unknown_terms": [
    {
      "source_term": "unapproved English term",
      "target_term": "provisional Chinese rendering used above",
      "context": "short reason this term is needed here"
    }
  ],
  "notes": []
}
```

List `term_occurrences` in textual order and include repeated terms repeatedly.
The pipeline, not the translator, attaches source hashes, model provenance,
status fields, context hash, timestamp, and deterministic QA results.

context.style_guide:
# 中文翻译风格规范

## 1. 语言

- 使用简体中文和正式数学书面语。
- 以准确、清楚为先，不追求文学化改写。
- 不使用“显然可知”“众所周知”等原文没有的评价。
- 不添加总结、提示、学习建议、免责声明或模型口吻。
- 原文有意重复时不得仅为避免中文重复而删除信息。

## 2. 术语

- `config/glossary.yml` 中 `approved` 词条具有约束力。
- `proposed` 词条只能用于讨论，不能作为批量翻译依据。
- 一个术语有多个语境译法时，必须按词条条件选择。
- 不确定时保留候选译文并填写 `unknown_terms`，不得静默创造新译法。
- 每一次数学术语出现都必须写成 `中文（English）`，不得只在首次出现时附英文。
- 双语术语使用中文全角括号，中文与左括号之间不留空格；括号内保留该处英文
  原词形。标题、列表、图表、脚注和正文适用同一规则。
- 人名等非数学专名不强制双语；首次出现时是否附英文由词表决定。

## 3. 数学逻辑

- 完整保留量词、否定、条件、唯一性和存在性。
- “当且仅当”不得缩写为只表达一个方向的句式。
- “至少”“至多”“恰有”“任意”“某个”必须逐一对应。
- `respectively` 必须保持对象顺序；中文过长时可拆句，但不能改变配对。
- 定义中的术语和条件优先逐项对应，不为流畅合并不同条件。

## 4. 标点和排版

- 中文正文使用全角中文标点。
- 数学模式、命令、标签、引用键、URL 和代码内部保持原 ASCII 形式。
- 中文与行内数学之间不手工插入不可控空格，由排版层统一处理。
- 括号内是完整中文说明时使用中文标点；纯数学内容保留数学标点。
- 不在译文数据中写死页码、定理号或章节号。
- 不得仅为消除不完整候选预览中的孤行、寡行或大块页尾留白而压缩或改写忠实译文；
  这类分页会随相邻单元加入而变化。只有裁切、重叠、不可读或结构错误才构成翻译级阻断。

## 5. 结构名称

章节、定义、引理、命题、定理、推论、证明、注记、例和练习的显示名称由模板
统一设置。译文数据不重复手写环境标题，除非英文节点本身有显式标题参数。

## 6. 引用

- `\ref`、`\cite` 等目标不可修改。
- 引用前后的中文可以调整语序，但不得改变引用所支持的陈述。
- 文献作者和标题按项目词表或文献数据库决定，不凭模型记忆标准化。

## 7. 译者说明

正文默认不加入译者注。确有必要时使用独立、可识别的审校元数据或项目批准的
专用环境，并通过单独 PR 审查；模型无权自行加入。
context.translator_prompt:
# Translator prompt v2

## Role

Translate only the supplied natural-language unit from the locked Stacks Project
source into simplified Chinese mathematical prose. The surrounding program owns
all LaTeX structure.

## Hard constraints

1. Preserve the source meaning, logical strength, order of claims, and scope of
   every qualifier. Add no explanation, example, assumption, conclusion, or
   translator note.
2. Copy every protected token such as `<MATH_0001>`, `<REF_0001>`, and
   `<CITE_0001>` exactly once and in the original order. Do not emit raw LaTeX.
3. Every occurrence of a mathematical term must retain both languages in the
   exact form `中文（English）`. This applies on every occurrence, not only the
   first one. Use full-width Chinese parentheses, put no space before them, and
   preserve the English form supplied for that occurrence.
4. Follow the approved glossary supplied in the context for the Chinese half of
   each bilingual term. If a needed term is not approved, use the best explicit
   provisional Chinese rendering, retain its English occurrence in parentheses,
   and report the occurrence in `term_occurrences` and the decision in
   `unknown_terms`; do not claim that the term is approved.
5. Leave only names, standard abbreviations, code, and explicitly allowed
   non-terminological English unchanged. Do not add Markdown or commentary
   outside the record.
6. Do not claim structural QA, independent criticism, language review,
   mathematics review, publication, or any human identity.

## Output

Return exactly one JSON object with these translator-owned fields:

```json
{
  "unit_id": "the input unit_id",
  "translation": "Chinese text with protected tokens and 中文（English） terms",
  "allowed_english": [],
  "term_occurrences": [
    {
      "source_term": "English spelling from this occurrence",
      "target_term": "Chinese rendering immediately before it"
    }
  ],
  "unknown_terms": [
    {
      "source_term": "unapproved English term",
      "target_term": "provisional Chinese rendering used above",
      "context": "short reason this term is needed here"
    }
  ],
  "notes": []
}
```

List `term_occurrences` in textual order and include repeated terms repeatedly.
The pipeline, not the translator, attaches source hashes, model provenance,
status fields, context hash, timestamp, and deterministic QA results.

schema: 1

source:
  lock_file: upstream.lock
  require_clean_harvest: true
  require_exact_commit: true
  allow_implicit_update: false

unit:
  preferred_min_source_words: 300
  preferred_max_source_words: 1500
  primary_identity: stacks_tag
  untagged_identity:
    - parent_tag
    - node_kind
    - ast_path
    - content_fingerprint
    - neighbor_fingerprint

stages:
  - UNTRANSLATED
  - AI_DRAFT
  - STRUCTURE_OK
  - TERM_OK
  - CRITIC_OK
  - LANGUAGE_REVIEWED
  - MATH_REVIEWED
  - PUBLISHED

source_statuses:
  - CURRENT
  - STALE_TEXT
  - STALE_MATH
  - PARTIAL_STALE
  - RETIRED

qa_statuses:
  - NOT_RUN
  - PASS
  - FAIL

term_statuses:
  - CLEAR
  - DECISION_REQUIRED

publication_statuses:
  - INTERNAL
  - CANDIDATE
  - RELEASED

risk_levels:
  R0:
    description: structure or generated metadata
    language_review: false
    mathematics_review: false
  R1:
    description: expository or historical prose
    language_review: true
    mathematics_review: false
  R2:
    description: mathematical examples, remarks, exercises, or exposition
    language_review: true
    mathematics_review: conditional
  R3:
    description: definitions, statements, and proofs
    language_review: true
    mathematics_review: true

promotion:
  require_current_source: true
  require_qa_pass: true
  require_clear_terms: true
  allow_model_as_human_reviewer: false
  translation_memory_minimum_stage: PUBLISHED

model_provenance:
  require_harness: true
  require_concrete_model: true
  require_model_record: true
  require_run_manifest: true
  candidate_main_merge_is_publication: false
  replacement_is_append_only: true
  historical_run_manifests_immutable: true
  derivations_require_exact_input_snapshots: true
  derivations_require_replay_and_output_hashes: true
  derivations_inherit_human_review: false
  archived_derivations_in_active_indexes: false
  model_corrections_require_separate_actual_run: true
  model_corrections_require_frozen_input_and_raw_output: true
  composite_previews_require_all_origin_disclosures: true

harness_version_resolution:
  strategy: execute_registered_command_per_run
  command: make harness-check HARNESS_ID=<harness-id>
  forbid_unknown_for_new_runs: true
  allow_unknown_only_in_legacy_manifests: true

parallelism:
  unit_single_writer: true
  batch_file_single_writer: true
  shared_policy_files_serial: true
  translator_and_critic_independent_context: true

local_latex_gate:
  required_before_commit: true
  required_before_pull_request: true
  require_zero_exit_status: true
  translation_candidate_commands:
    - make render MODEL=<model-lane>
    - make pdf MODEL=<model-lane>
  other_change_commands:
    - make render MODEL=openai-gpt-5.6-sol
    - make pdf MODEL=openai-gpt-5.6-sol
  template_change_command: make template
  allow_missing_toolchain: false

task_assignment:
  coordination_system: github_issues
  issue_required_before_pull_request: true
  issue_must_be_claimed: true
  issue_branch_must_match_pull_request: true
  required_coordinates:
    - source_commit
    - chapter
    - parent_tag
    - unit_ids
  forbid_page_or_line_ranges: true
  require_declared_write_files: true
  require_nonoverlapping_units: true
  branch_tag_slug_case: lowercase

pull_requests:
  require_exactly_one_closing_issue: true
  require_pr_contract_status: true
  translation_scope: one_section_or_contiguous_units
  one_model_lane: true
  one_harness_and_model_per_candidate_run: true
  separate_terminology_changes: true
  separate_upstream_sync: true
  separate_tooling_changes: true

In this section we prove some lemmas on representing
Cartier divisors by suitable effective Cartier divisors
on blowups. These lemmas can be found in <CITE_0001>.
We have adapted the formulation so they also work
in the non-finite type setting. It may happen that the morphism <MATH_0001>
of Lemma <REF_0001> is a composition of
infinitely many blowups, but over any given quasi-compact open
<MATH_0002> one needs only finitely many blowups
(and this is the result of loc.<SPACE_0001>cit.).

# 中文翻译风格规范

## 1. 语言

- 使用简体中文和正式数学书面语。
- 以准确、清楚为先，不追求文学化改写。
- 不使用“显然可知”“众所周知”等原文没有的评价。
- 不添加总结、提示、学习建议、免责声明或模型口吻。
- 原文有意重复时不得仅为避免中文重复而删除信息。

## 2. 术语

- `config/glossary.yml` 中 `approved` 词条具有约束力。
- `proposed` 词条只能用于讨论，不能作为批量翻译依据。
- 一个术语有多个语境译法时，必须按词条条件选择。
- 不确定时保留候选译文并填写 `unknown_terms`，不得静默创造新译法。
- 每一次数学术语出现都必须写成 `中文（English）`，不得只在首次出现时附英文。
- 双语术语使用中文全角括号，中文与左括号之间不留空格；括号内保留该处英文
  原词形。标题、列表、图表、脚注和正文适用同一规则。
- 人名等非数学专名不强制双语；首次出现时是否附英文由词表决定。

## 3. 数学逻辑

- 完整保留量词、否定、条件、唯一性和存在性。
- “当且仅当”不得缩写为只表达一个方向的句式。
- “至少”“至多”“恰有”“任意”“某个”必须逐一对应。
- `respectively` 必须保持对象顺序；中文过长时可拆句，但不能改变配对。
- 定义中的术语和条件优先逐项对应，不为流畅合并不同条件。

## 4. 标点和排版

- 中文正文使用全角中文标点。
- 数学模式、命令、标签、引用键、URL 和代码内部保持原 ASCII 形式。
- 中文与行内数学之间不手工插入不可控空格，由排版层统一处理。
- 括号内是完整中文说明时使用中文标点；纯数学内容保留数学标点。
- 不在译文数据中写死页码、定理号或章节号。
- 不得仅为消除不完整候选预览中的孤行、寡行或大块页尾留白而压缩或改写忠实译文；
  这类分页会随相邻单元加入而变化。只有裁切、重叠、不可读或结构错误才构成翻译级阻断。

## 5. 结构名称

章节、定义、引理、命题、定理、推论、证明、注记、例和练习的显示名称由模板
统一设置。译文数据不重复手写环境标题，除非英文节点本身有显式标题参数。

## 6. 引用

- `\ref`、`\cite` 等目标不可修改。
- 引用前后的中文可以调整语序，但不得改变引用所支持的陈述。
- 文献作者和标题按项目词表或文献数据库决定，不凭模型记忆标准化。

## 7. 译者说明

正文默认不加入译者注。确有必要时使用独立、可识别的审校元数据或项目批准的
专用环境，并通过单独 PR 审查；模型无权自行加入。
context.translator_prompt:
# Translator prompt v2

## Role

Translate only the supplied natural-language unit from the locked Stacks Project
source into simplified Chinese mathematical prose. The surrounding program owns
all LaTeX structure.

## Hard constraints

1. Preserve the source meaning, logical strength, order of claims, and scope of
   every qualifier. Add no explanation, example, assumption, conclusion, or
   translator note.
2. Copy every protected token such as `<MATH_0001>`, `<REF_0001>`, and
   `<CITE_0001>` exactly once and in the original order. Do not emit raw LaTeX.
3. Every occurrence of a mathematical term must retain both languages in the
   exact form `中文（English）`. This applies on every occurrence, not only the
   first one. Use full-width Chinese parentheses, put no space before them, and
   preserve the English form supplied for that occurrence.
4. Follow the approved glossary supplied in the context for the Chinese half of
   each bilingual term. If a needed term is not approved, use the best explicit
   provisional Chinese rendering, retain its English occurrence in parentheses,
   and report the occurrence in `term_occurrences` and the decision in
   `unknown_terms`; do not claim that the term is approved.
5. Leave only names, standard abbreviations, code, and explicitly allowed
   non-terminological English unchanged. Do not add Markdown or commentary
   outside the record.
6. Do not claim structural QA, independent criticism, language review,
   mathematics review, publication, or any human identity.

## Output

Return exactly one JSON object with these translator-owned fields:

```json
{
  "unit_id": "the input unit_id",
  "translation": "Chinese text with protected tokens and 中文（English） terms",
  "allowed_english": [],
  "term_occurrences": [
    {
      "source_term": "English spelling from this occurrence",
      "target_term": "Chinese rendering immediately before it"
    }
  ],
  "unknown_terms": [
    {
      "source_term": "unapproved English term",
      "target_term": "provisional Chinese rendering used above",
      "context": "short reason this term is needed here"
    }
  ],
  "notes": []
}
```

List `term_occurrences` in textual order and include repeated terms repeatedly.
The pipeline, not the translator, attaches source hashes, model provenance,
status fields, context hash, timestamp, and deterministic QA results.

context.style_guide:
# 中文翻译风格规范

## 1. 语言

- 使用简体中文和正式数学书面语。
- 以准确、清楚为先，不追求文学化改写。
- 不使用“显然可知”“众所周知”等原文没有的评价。
- 不添加总结、提示、学习建议、免责声明或模型口吻。
- 原文有意重复时不得仅为避免中文重复而删除信息。

## 2. 术语

- `config/glossary.yml` 中 `approved` 词条具有约束力。
- `proposed` 词条只能用于讨论，不能作为批量翻译依据。
- 一个术语有多个语境译法时，必须按词条条件选择。
- 不确定时保留候选译文并填写 `unknown_terms`，不得静默创造新译法。
- 每一次数学术语出现都必须写成 `中文（English）`，不得只在首次出现时附英文。
- 双语术语使用中文全角括号，中文与左括号之间不留空格；括号内保留该处英文
  原词形。标题、列表、图表、脚注和正文适用同一规则。
- 人名等非数学专名不强制双语；首次出现时是否附英文由词表决定。

## 3. 数学逻辑

- 完整保留量词、否定、条件、唯一性和存在性。
- “当且仅当”不得缩写为只表达一个方向的句式。
- “至少”“至多”“恰有”“任意”“某个”必须逐一对应。
- `respectively` 必须保持对象顺序；中文过长时可拆句，但不能改变配对。
- 定义中的术语和条件优先逐项对应，不为流畅合并不同条件。

## 4. 标点和排版

- 中文正文使用全角中文标点。
- 数学模式、命令、标签、引用键、URL 和代码内部保持原 ASCII 形式。
- 中文与行内数学之间不手工插入不可控空格，由排版层统一处理。
- 括号内是完整中文说明时使用中文标点；纯数学内容保留数学标点。
- 不在译文数据中写死页码、定理号或章节号。
- 不得仅为消除不完整候选预览中的孤行、寡行或大块页尾留白而压缩或改写忠实译文；
  这类分页会随相邻单元加入而变化。只有裁切、重叠、不可读或结构错误才构成翻译级阻断。

## 5. 结构名称

章节、定义、引理、命题、定理、推论、证明、注记、例和练习的显示名称由模板
统一设置。译文数据不重复手写环境标题，除非英文节点本身有显式标题参数。

## 6. 引用

- `\ref`、`\cite` 等目标不可修改。
- 引用前后的中文可以调整语序，但不得改变引用所支持的陈述。
- 文献作者和标题按项目词表或文献数据库决定，不凭模型记忆标准化。

## 7. 译者说明

正文默认不加入译者注。确有必要时使用独立、可识别的审校元数据或项目批准的
专用环境，并通过单独 PR 审查；模型无权自行加入。
context.translator_prompt:
# Translator prompt v2

## Role

Translate only the supplied natural-language unit from the locked Stacks Project
source into simplified Chinese mathematical prose. The surrounding program owns
all LaTeX structure.

## Hard constraints

1. Preserve the source meaning, logical strength, order of claims, and scope of
   every qualifier. Add no explanation, example, assumption, conclusion, or
   translator note.
2. Copy every protected token such as `<MATH_0001>`, `<REF_0001>`, and
   `<CITE_0001>` exactly once and in the original order. Do not emit raw LaTeX.
3. Every occurrence of a mathematical term must retain both languages in the
   exact form `中文（English）`. This applies on every occurrence, not only the
   first one. Use full-width Chinese parentheses, put no space before them, and
   preserve the English form supplied for that occurrence.
4. Follow the approved glossary supplied in the context for the Chinese half of
   each bilingual term. If a needed term is not approved, use the best explicit
   provisional Chinese rendering, retain its English occurrence in parentheses,
   and report the occurrence in `term_occurrences` and the decision in
   `unknown_terms`; do not claim that the term is approved.
5. Leave only names, standard abbreviations, code, and explicitly allowed
   non-terminological English unchanged. Do not add Markdown or commentary
   outside the record.
6. Do not claim structural QA, independent criticism, language review,
   mathematics review, publication, or any human identity.

## Output

Return exactly one JSON object with these translator-owned fields:

```json
{
  "unit_id": "the input unit_id",
  "translation": "Chinese text with protected tokens and 中文（English） terms",
  "allowed_english": [],
  "term_occurrences": [
    {
      "source_term": "English spelling from this occurrence",
      "target_term": "Chinese rendering immediately before it"
    }
  ],
  "unknown_terms": [
    {
      "source_term": "unapproved English term",
      "target_term": "provisional Chinese rendering used above",
      "context": "short reason this term is needed here"
    }
  ],
  "notes": []
}
```

List `term_occurrences` in textual order and include repeated terms repeatedly.
The pipeline, not the translator, attaches source hashes, model provenance,
status fields, context hash, timestamp, and deterministic QA results.

- 不添加总结、提示、学习建议、免责声明或模型口吻。
- 原文有意重复时不得仅为避免中文重复而删除信息。

## 2. 术语

- `config/glossary.yml` 中 `approved` 词条具有约束力。
- `proposed` 词条只能用于讨论，不能作为批量翻译依据。
- 一个术语有多个语境译法时，必须按词条条件选择。
- 不确定时保留候选译文并填写 `unknown_terms`，不得静默创造新译法。
- 每一次数学术语出现都必须写成 `中文（English）`，不得只在首次出现时附英文。
- 双语术语使用中文全角括号，中文与左括号之间不留空格；括号内保留该处英文
  原词形。标题、列表、图表、脚注和正文适用同一规则。
- 人名等非数学专名不强制双语；首次出现时是否附英文由词表决定。

## 3. 数学逻辑

- 完整保留量词、否定、条件、唯一性和存在性。
- “当且仅当”不得缩写为只表达一个方向的句式。
- “至少”“至多”“恰有”“任意”“某个”必须逐一对应。
- `respectively` 必须保持对象顺序；中文过长时可拆句，但不能改变配对。
- 定义中的术语和条件优先逐项对应，不为流畅合并不同条件。

## 4. 标点和排版

- 中文正文使用全角中文标点。
- 数学模式、命令、标签、引用键、URL 和代码内部保持原 ASCII 形式。
- 中文与行内数学之间不手工插入不可控空格，由排版层统一处理。
- 括号内是完整中文说明时使用中文标点；纯数学内容保留数学标点。
- 不在译文数据中写死页码、定理号或章节号。
- 不得仅为消除不完整候选预览中的孤行、寡行或大块页尾留白而压缩或改写忠实译文；
  这类分页会随相邻单元加入而变化。只有裁切、重叠、不可读或结构错误才构成翻译级阻断。

## 5. 结构名称

章节、定义、引理、命题、定理、推论、证明、注记、例和练习的显示名称由模板
统一设置。译文数据不重复手写环境标题，除非英文节点本身有显式标题参数。

## 6. 引用

- `\ref`、`\cite` 等目标不可修改。
- 引用前后的中文可以调整语序，但不得改变引用所支持的陈述。
- 文献作者和标题按项目词表或文献数据库决定，不凭模型记忆标准化。

## 7. 译者说明

正文默认不加入译者注。确有必要时使用独立、可识别的审校元数据或项目批准的
专用环境，并通过单独 PR 审查；模型无权自行加入。
context.translator_prompt:
# Translator prompt v2

## Role

Translate only the supplied natural-language unit from the locked Stacks Project
source into simplified Chinese mathematical prose. The surrounding program owns
all LaTeX structure.

## Hard constraints

1. Preserve the source meaning, logical strength, order of claims, and scope of
   every qualifier. Add no explanation, example, assumption, conclusion, or
   translator note.
2. Copy every protected token such as `<MATH_0001>`, `<REF_0001>`, and
   `<CITE_0001>` exactly once and in the original order. Do not emit raw LaTeX.
3. Every occurrence of a mathematical term must retain both languages in the
   exact form `中文（English）`. This applies on every occurrence, not only the
   first one. Use full-width Chinese parentheses, put no space before them, and
   preserve the English form supplied for that occurrence.
4. Follow the approved glossary supplied in the context for the Chinese half of
   each bilingual term. If a needed term is not approved, use the best explicit
   provisional Chinese rendering, retain its English occurrence in parentheses,
   and report the occurrence in `term_occurrences` and the decision in
   `unknown_terms`; do not claim that the term is approved.
5. Leave only names, standard abbreviations, code, and explicitly allowed
   non-terminological English unchanged. Do not add Markdown or commentary
   outside the record.
6. Do not claim structural QA, independent criticism, language review,
   mathematics review, publication, or any human identity.

## Output

Return exactly one JSON object with these translator-owned fields:

```json
{
  "unit_id": "the input unit_id",
  "translation": "Chinese text with protected tokens and 中文（English） terms",
  "allowed_english": [],
  "term_occurrences": [
    {
      "source_term": "English spelling from this occurrence",
      "target_term": "Chinese rendering immediately before it"
    }
  ],
  "unknown_terms": [
    {
      "source_term": "unapproved English term",
      "target_term": "provisional Chinese rendering used above",
      "context": "short reason this term is needed here"
    }
  ],
  "notes": []
}
```

List `term_occurrences` in textual order and include repeated terms repeatedly.
The pipeline, not the translator, attaches source hashes, model provenance,
status fields, context hash, timestamp, and deterministic QA results.

context.style_guide:
# 中文翻译风格规范

## 1. 语言

- 使用简体中文和正式数学书面语。
- 以准确、清楚为先，不追求文学化改写。
- 不使用“显然可知”“众所周知”等原文没有的评价。
- 不添加总结、提示、学习建议、免责声明或模型口吻。
- 原文有意重复时不得仅为避免中文重复而删除信息。

## 2. 术语

- `config/glossary.yml` 中 `approved` 词条具有约束力。
- `proposed` 词条只能用于讨论，不能作为批量翻译依据。
- 一个术语有多个语境译法时，必须按词条条件选择。
- 不确定时保留候选译文并填写 `unknown_terms`，不得静默创造新译法。
- 每一次数学术语出现都必须写成 `中文（English）`，不得只在首次出现时附英文。
- 双语术语使用中文全角括号，中文与左括号之间不留空格；括号内保留该处英文
  原词形。标题、列表、图表、脚注和正文适用同一规则。
- 人名等非数学专名不强制双语；首次出现时是否附英文由词表决定。

## 3. 数学逻辑

- 完整保留量词、否定、条件、唯一性和存在性。
- “当且仅当”不得缩写为只表达一个方向的句式。
- “至少”“至多”“恰有”“任意”“某个”必须逐一对应。
- `respectively` 必须保持对象顺序；中文过长时可拆句，但不能改变配对。
- 定义中的术语和条件优先逐项对应，不为流畅合并不同条件。

## 4. 标点和排版

- 中文正文使用全角中文标点。
- 数学模式、命令、标签、引用键、URL 和代码内部保持原 ASCII 形式。
- 中文与行内数学之间不手工插入不可控空格，由排版层统一处理。
- 括号内是完整中文说明时使用中文标点；纯数学内容保留数学标点。
- 不在译文数据中写死页码、定理号或章节号。
- 不得仅为消除不完整候选预览中的孤行、寡行或大块页尾留白而压缩或改写忠实译文；
  这类分页会随相邻单元加入而变化。只有裁切、重叠、不可读或结构错误才构成翻译级阻断。

## 5. 结构名称

章节、定义、引理、命题、定理、推论、证明、注记、例和练习的显示名称由模板
统一设置。译文数据不重复手写环境标题，除非英文节点本身有显式标题参数。

## 6. 引用

- `\ref`、`\cite` 等目标不可修改。
- 引用前后的中文可以调整语序，但不得改变引用所支持的陈述。
- 文献作者和标题按项目词表或文献数据库决定，不凭模型记忆标准化。

## 7. 译者说明

正文默认不加入译者注。确有必要时使用独立、可识别的审校元数据或项目批准的
专用环境，并通过单独 PR 审查；模型无权自行加入。
context.translator_prompt:
# Translator prompt v2

## Role

Translate only the supplied natural-language unit from the locked Stacks Project
source into simplified Chinese mathematical prose. The surrounding program owns
all LaTeX structure.

## Hard constraints

1. Preserve the source meaning, logical strength, order of claims, and scope of
   every qualifier. Add no explanation, example, assumption, conclusion, or
   translator note.
2. Copy every protected token such as `<MATH_0001>`, `<REF_0001>`, and
   `<CITE_0001>` exactly once and in the original order. Do not emit raw LaTeX.
3. Every occurrence of a mathematical term must retain both languages in the
   exact form `中文（English）`. This applies on every occurrence, not only the
   first one. Use full-width Chinese parentheses, put no space before them, and
   preserve the English form supplied for that occurrence.
4. Follow the approved glossary supplied in the context for the Chinese half of
   each bilingual term. If a needed term is not approved, use the best explicit
   provisional Chinese rendering, retain its English occurrence in parentheses,
   and report the occurrence in `term_occurrences` and the decision in
   `unknown_terms`; do not claim that the term is approved.
5. Leave only names, standard abbreviations, code, and explicitly allowed
   non-terminological English unchanged. Do not add Markdown or commentary
   outside the record.
6. Do not claim structural QA, independent criticism, language review,
   mathematics review, publication, or any human identity.

## Output

Return exactly one JSON object with these translator-owned fields:

```json
{
  "unit_id": "the input unit_id",
  "translation": "Chinese text with protected tokens and 中文（English） terms",
  "allowed_english": [],
  "term_occurrences": [
    {
      "source_term": "English spelling from this occurrence",
      "target_term": "Chinese rendering immediately before it"
    }
  ],
  "unknown_terms": [
    {
      "source_term": "unapproved English term",
      "target_term": "provisional Chinese rendering used above",
      "context": "short reason this term is needed here"
    }
  ],
  "notes": []
}
```

List `term_occurrences` in textual order and include repeated terms repeatedly.
The pipeline, not the translator, attaches source hashes, model provenance,
status fields, context hash, timestamp, and deterministic QA results.

schema: 1

source:
  lock_file: upstream.lock
  require_clean_harvest: true
  require_exact_commit: true
  allow_implicit_update: false

unit:
  preferred_min_source_words: 300
  preferred_max_source_words: 1500
  primary_identity: stacks_tag
  untagged_identity:
    - parent_tag
    - node_kind
    - ast_path
    - content_fingerprint
    - neighbor_fingerprint

stages:
  - UNTRANSLATED
  - AI_DRAFT
  - STRUCTURE_OK
  - TERM_OK
  - CRITIC_OK
  - LANGUAGE_REVIEWED
  - MATH_REVIEWED
  - PUBLISHED

source_statuses:
  - CURRENT
  - STALE_TEXT
  - STALE_MATH
  - PARTIAL_STALE
  - RETIRED

qa_statuses:
  - NOT_RUN
  - PASS
  - FAIL

term_statuses:
  - CLEAR
  - DECISION_REQUIRED

publication_statuses:
  - INTERNAL
  - CANDIDATE
  - RELEASED

risk_levels:
  R0:
    description: structure or generated metadata
    language_review: false
    mathematics_review: false
  R1:
    description: expository or historical prose
    language_review: true
    mathematics_review: false
  R2:
    description: mathematical examples, remarks, exercises, or exposition
    language_review: true
    mathematics_review: conditional
  R3:
    description: definitions, statements, and proofs
    language_review: true
    mathematics_review: true

promotion:
  require_current_source: true
  require_qa_pass: true
  require_clear_terms: true
  allow_model_as_human_reviewer: false
  translation_memory_minimum_stage: PUBLISHED

model_provenance:
  require_harness: true
  require_concrete_model: true
  require_model_record: true
  require_run_manifest: true
  candidate_main_merge_is_publication: false
  replacement_is_append_only: true
  historical_run_manifests_immutable: true
  derivations_require_exact_input_snapshots: true
  derivations_require_replay_and_output_hashes: true
  derivations_inherit_human_review: false
  archived_derivations_in_active_indexes: false
  model_corrections_require_separate_actual_run: true
  model_corrections_require_frozen_input_and_raw_output: true
  composite_previews_require_all_origin_disclosures: true

harness_version_resolution:
  strategy: execute_registered_command_per_run
  command: make harness-check HARNESS_ID=<harness-id>
  forbid_unknown_for_new_runs: true
  allow_unknown_only_in_legacy_manifests: true

parallelism:
  unit_single_writer: true
  batch_file_single_writer: true
  shared_policy_files_serial: true
  translator_and_critic_independent_context: true

local_latex_gate:
  required_before_commit: true
  required_before_pull_request: true
  require_zero_exit_status: true
  translation_candidate_commands:
    - make render MODEL=<model-lane>
    - make pdf MODEL=<model-lane>
  other_change_commands:
    - make render MODEL=openai-gpt-5.6-sol
    - make pdf MODEL=openai-gpt-5.6-sol
  template_change_command: make template
  allow_missing_toolchain: false

设<MATH_0001>如《周同调（Chow Homology）》的情形<REF_0001>。设<MATH_0002>在<MATH_0003>上局部有限型（locally of finite type）。假设<MATH_0004>是整的（integral），且<MATH_0005>。设<MATH_0006>是可逆的（invertible）<MATH_0007>-模（module）。设<MATH_0008>是<MATH_0009>的非零亚纯截面（nonzero meromorphic section）。设<MATH_0010>为最大的开子概形（open subscheme），使<MATH_0011>对应于<MATH_0012>在<MATH_0013>上的截面（section）。存在射影态射（projective morphism）
<MATH_0014>
使得
<STRUCT_0001>
<STRUCT_0002> <MATH_0015>是整的（integral），
<STRUCT_0003> <MATH_0016>是同构（isomorphism），
<STRUCT_0004> 存在有效卡蒂埃除子（effective Cartier divisors）<MATH_0017>，使
<MATH_0018>
<STRUCT_0005> 亚纯截面（meromorphic section）<MATH_0019>通过上述同构（isomorphism）对应于亚纯截面（meromorphic section）<MATH_0020>（见《除子（Divisors）》定义<REF_0002>），
<STRUCT_0006> 有
<MATH_0021>
在<MATH_0022>中成立。

context.style_guide:
# 中文翻译风格规范

## 1. 语言

- 使用简体中文和正式数学书面语。
- 以准确、清楚为先，不追求文学化改写。
- 不使用“显然可知”“众所周知”等原文没有的评价。
- 不添加总结、提示、学习建议、免责声明或模型口吻。
- 原文有意重复时不得仅为避免中文重复而删除信息。

## 2. 术语

- `config/glossary.yml` 中 `approved` 词条具有约束力。
- `proposed` 词条只能用于讨论，不能作为批量翻译依据。
- 一个术语有多个语境译法时，必须按词条条件选择。
- 不确定时保留候选译文并填写 `unknown_terms`，不得静默创造新译法。
- 每一次数学术语出现都必须写成 `中文（English）`，不得只在首次出现时附英文。
- 双语术语使用中文全角括号，中文与左括号之间不留空格；括号内保留该处英文
  原词形。标题、列表、图表、脚注和正文适用同一规则。
- 人名等非数学专名不强制双语；首次出现时是否附英文由词表决定。

## 3. 数学逻辑

- 完整保留量词、否定、条件、唯一性和存在性。
- “当且仅当”不得缩写为只表达一个方向的句式。
- “至少”“至多”“恰有”“任意”“某个”必须逐一对应。
- `respectively` 必须保持对象顺序；中文过长时可拆句，但不能改变配对。
- 定义中的术语和条件优先逐项对应，不为流畅合并不同条件。

## 4. 标点和排版

- 中文正文使用全角中文标点。
- 数学模式、命令、标签、引用键、URL 和代码内部保持原 ASCII 形式。
- 中文与行内数学之间不手工插入不可控空格，由排版层统一处理。
- 括号内是完整中文说明时使用中文标点；纯数学内容保留数学标点。
- 不在译文数据中写死页码、定理号或章节号。
- 不得仅为消除不完整候选预览中的孤行、寡行或大块页尾留白而压缩或改写忠实译文；
  这类分页会随相邻单元加入而变化。只有裁切、重叠、不可读或结构错误才构成翻译级阻断。

## 5. 结构名称

章节、定义、引理、命题、定理、推论、证明、注记、例和练习的显示名称由模板
统一设置。译文数据不重复手写环境标题，除非英文节点本身有显式标题参数。

## 6. 引用

- `\ref`、`\cite` 等目标不可修改。
- 引用前后的中文可以调整语序，但不得改变引用所支持的陈述。
- 文献作者和标题按项目词表或文献数据库决定，不凭模型记忆标准化。

## 7. 译者说明

正文默认不加入译者注。确有必要时使用独立、可识别的审校元数据或项目批准的
专用环境，并通过单独 PR 审查；模型无权自行加入。
context.translator_prompt:
# Translator prompt v2

## Role

Translate only the supplied natural-language unit from the locked Stacks Project
source into simplified Chinese mathematical prose. The surrounding program owns
all LaTeX structure.

## Hard constraints

1. Preserve the source meaning, logical strength, order of claims, and scope of
   every qualifier. Add no explanation, example, assumption, conclusion, or
   translator note.
2. Copy every protected token such as `<MATH_0001>`, `<REF_0001>`, and
   `<CITE_0001>` exactly once and in the original order. Do not emit raw LaTeX.
3. Every occurrence of a mathematical term must retain both languages in the
   exact form `中文（English）`. This applies on every occurrence, not only the
   first one. Use full-width Chinese parentheses, put no space before them, and
   preserve the English form supplied for that occurrence.
4. Follow the approved glossary supplied in the context for the Chinese half of
   each bilingual term. If a needed term is not approved, use the best explicit
   provisional Chinese rendering, retain its English occurrence in parentheses,
   and report the occurrence in `term_occurrences` and the decision in
   `unknown_terms`; do not claim that the term is approved.
5. Leave only names, standard abbreviations, code, and explicitly allowed
   non-terminological English unchanged. Do not add Markdown or commentary
   outside the record.
6. Do not claim structural QA, independent criticism, language review,
   mathematics review, publication, or any human identity.

## Output

Return exactly one JSON object with these translator-owned fields:

```json
{
  "unit_id": "the input unit_id",
  "translation": "Chinese text with protected tokens and 中文（English） terms",
  "allowed_english": [],
  "term_occurrences": [
    {
      "source_term": "English spelling from this occurrence",
      "target_term": "Chinese rendering immediately before it"
    }
  ],
  "unknown_terms": [
    {
      "source_term": "unapproved English term",
      "target_term": "provisional Chinese rendering used above",
      "context": "short reason this term is needed here"
    }
  ],
  "notes": []
}
```

List `term_occurrences` in textual order and include repeated terms repeatedly.
The pipeline, not the translator, attaches source hashes, model provenance,
status fields, context hash, timestamp, and deterministic QA results.

context.style_guide:
# 中文翻译风格规范

## 1. 语言

- 使用简体中文和正式数学书面语。
- 以准确、清楚为先，不追求文学化改写。
- 不使用“显然可知”“众所周知”等原文没有的评价。
- 不添加总结、提示、学习建议、免责声明或模型口吻。
- 原文有意重复时不得仅为避免中文重复而删除信息。

## 2. 术语

- `config/glossary.yml` 中 `approved` 词条具有约束力。
- `proposed` 词条只能用于讨论，不能作为批量翻译依据。
- 一个术语有多个语境译法时，必须按词条条件选择。
- 不确定时保留候选译文并填写 `unknown_terms`，不得静默创造新译法。
- 每一次数学术语出现都必须写成 `中文（English）`，不得只在首次出现时附英文。
- 双语术语使用中文全角括号，中文与左括号之间不留空格；括号内保留该处英文
  原词形。标题、列表、图表、脚注和正文适用同一规则。
- 人名等非数学专名不强制双语；首次出现时是否附英文由词表决定。

## 3. 数学逻辑

- 完整保留量词、否定、条件、唯一性和存在性。
- “当且仅当”不得缩写为只表达一个方向的句式。
- “至少”“至多”“恰有”“任意”“某个”必须逐一对应。
- `respectively` 必须保持对象顺序；中文过长时可拆句，但不能改变配对。
- 定义中的术语和条件优先逐项对应，不为流畅合并不同条件。

## 4. 标点和排版

- 中文正文使用全角中文标点。
- 数学模式、命令、标签、引用键、URL 和代码内部保持原 ASCII 形式。
- 中文与行内数学之间不手工插入不可控空格，由排版层统一处理。
- 括号内是完整中文说明时使用中文标点；纯数学内容保留数学标点。
- 不在译文数据中写死页码、定理号或章节号。
- 不得仅为消除不完整候选预览中的孤行、寡行或大块页尾留白而压缩或改写忠实译文；
  这类分页会随相邻单元加入而变化。只有裁切、重叠、不可读或结构错误才构成翻译级阻断。

## 5. 结构名称

章节、定义、引理、命题、定理、推论、证明、注记、例和练习的显示名称由模板
统一设置。译文数据不重复手写环境标题，除非英文节点本身有显式标题参数。

## 6. 引用

- `\ref`、`\cite` 等目标不可修改。
- 引用前后的中文可以调整语序，但不得改变引用所支持的陈述。
- 文献作者和标题按项目词表或文献数据库决定，不凭模型记忆标准化。

## 7. 译者说明

正文默认不加入译者注。确有必要时使用独立、可识别的审校元数据或项目批准的
专用环境，并通过单独 PR 审查；模型无权自行加入。
context.translator_prompt:
# Translator prompt v2

## Role

Translate only the supplied natural-language unit from the locked Stacks Project
source into simplified Chinese mathematical prose. The surrounding program owns
all LaTeX structure.

## Hard constraints

1. Preserve the source meaning, logical strength, order of claims, and scope of
   every qualifier. Add no explanation, example, assumption, conclusion, or
   translator note.
2. Copy every protected token such as `<MATH_0001>`, `<REF_0001>`, and
   `<CITE_0001>` exactly once and in the original order. Do not emit raw LaTeX.
3. Every occurrence of a mathematical term must retain both languages in the
   exact form `中文（English）`. This applies on every occurrence, not only the
   first one. Use full-width Chinese parentheses, put no space before them, and
   preserve the English form supplied for that occurrence.
4. Follow the approved glossary supplied in the context for the Chinese half of
   each bilingual term. If a needed term is not approved, use the best explicit
   provisional Chinese rendering, retain its English occurrence in parentheses,
   and report the occurrence in `term_occurrences` and the decision in
   `unknown_terms`; do not claim that the term is approved.
5. Leave only names, standard abbreviations, code, and explicitly allowed
   non-terminological English unchanged. Do not add Markdown or commentary
   outside the record.
6. Do not claim structural QA, independent criticism, language review,
   mathematics review, publication, or any human identity.

## Output

Return exactly one JSON object with these translator-owned fields:

```json
{
  "unit_id": "the input unit_id",
  "translation": "Chinese text with protected tokens and 中文（English） terms",
  "allowed_english": [],
  "term_occurrences": [
    {
      "source_term": "English spelling from this occurrence",
      "target_term": "Chinese rendering immediately before it"
    }
  ],
  "unknown_terms": [
    {
      "source_term": "unapproved English term",
      "target_term": "provisional Chinese rendering used above",
      "context": "short reason this term is needed here"
    }
  ],
  "notes": []
}
```

List `term_occurrences` in textual order and include repeated terms repeatedly.
The pipeline, not the translator, attaches source hashes, model provenance,
status fields, context hash, timestamp, and deterministic QA results.
context.workflow_policy:
schema: 1

source:
  lock_file: upstream.lock
  require_clean_harvest: true
  require_exact_commit: true
  allow_implicit_update: false

unit:
  preferred_min_source_words: 300
  preferred_max_source_words: 1500
  primary_identity: stacks_tag
  untagged_identity:
    - parent_tag
    - node_kind
    - ast_path
    - content_fingerprint
    - neighbor_fingerprint

stages:
  - UNTRANSLATED
  - AI_DRAFT
  - STRUCTURE_OK
  - TERM_OK
  - CRITIC_OK
  - LANGUAGE_REVIEWED
  - MATH_REVIEWED
  - PUBLISHED

source_statuses:
  - CURRENT
  - STALE_TEXT
  - STALE_MATH
  - PARTIAL_STALE
  - RETIRED

qa_statuses:
  - NOT_RUN
  - PASS
  - FAIL

term_statuses:
  - CLEAR
  - DECISION_REQUIRED

publication_statuses:
  - INTERNAL
  - CANDIDATE
  - RELEASED

risk_levels:
  R0:
    description: structure or generated metadata
    language_review: false
    mathematics_review: false
  R1:
    description: expository or historical prose
    language_review: true
    mathematics_review: false
  R2:
    description: mathematical examples, remarks, exercises, or exposition
    language_review: true
    mathematics_review: conditional
  R3:
    description: definitions, statements, and proofs
    language_review: true
    mathematics_review: true

promotion:
  require_current_source: true
  require_qa_pass: true
  require_clear_terms: true
  allow_model_as_human_reviewer: false
  translation_memory_minimum_stage: PUBLISHED

model_provenance:
  require_harness: true
  require_concrete_model: true
  require_model_record: true
  require_run_manifest: true
  candidate_main_merge_is_publication: false
  replacement_is_append_only: true
  historical_run_manifests_immutable: true
  derivations_require_exact_input_snapshots: true
  derivations_require_replay_and_output_hashes: true
  derivations_inherit_human_review: false
  archived_derivations_in_active_indexes: false
  model_corrections_require_separate_actual_run: true
  model_corrections_require_frozen_input_and_raw_output: true
  composite_previews_require_all_origin_disclosures: true

harness_version_resolution:
  strategy: execute_registered_command_per_run
  command: make harness-check HARNESS_ID=<harness-id>
  forbid_unknown_for_new_runs: true
  allow_unknown_only_in_legacy_manifests: true

parallelism:
  unit_single_writer: true
  batch_file_single_writer: true
  shared_policy_files_serial: true
  translator_and_critic_independent_context: true

local_latex_gate:
  required_before_commit: true
  required_before_pull_request: true
  require_zero_exit_status: true
  translation_candidate_commands:
    - make render MODEL=<model-lane>
    - make pdf MODEL=<model-lane>
  other_change_commands:
    - make render MODEL=openai-gpt-5.6-sol
    - make pdf MODEL=openai-gpt-5.6-sol
  template_change_command: make template
  allow_missing_toolchain: false

task_assignment:
  coordination_system: github_issues
  issue_required_before_pull_request: true
  issue_must_be_claimed: true
  issue_branch_must_match_pull_request: true
  required_coordinates:
    - source_commit
    - chapter
    - parent_tag
    - unit_ids
  forbid_page_or_line_ranges: true
  require_declared_write_files: true
  require_nonoverlapping_units: true
  branch_tag_slug_case: lowercase

pull_requests:
  require_exactly_one_closing_issue: true
  require_pr_contract_status: true
  translation_scope: one_section_or_contiguous_units
  one_model_lane: true
  one_harness_and_model_per_candidate_run: true
  separate_terminology_changes: true
  separate_upstream_sync: true
  separate_tooling_changes: true
